articles.title: A new GOG Galaxy is coming in 2027 with full Linux support
articles.summary: GOG just held their first GOG Showcase, and in it they confirmed that in 2027 we'll see GOG Galaxy fully supported on Linux. Read the full article on GamingOnLinux .

articles.title: The Kotlin Multiplatform Contest Is Open: Win a Trip to KotlinConf
articles.summary: The Kotlin Multiplatform Contest is back! Students and recent graduates, turn your idea into a cross-platform project with Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP). The authors of the top three projects will each win a trip to KotlinConf 2027 in Kraków, Poland, with conference tickets, travel, and accommodation covered by the Kotlin Foundation.

articles.title: OpenAIs GPT-6 Cyber can both break into systems and propose how to fix them
articles.summary: On ExploitGym, a benchmark that tests whether a model can exploit a given vulnerability in a remote system, GPT-6 Cyber scores 48.5 percent according to OpenAI, compared to 32.1 percent for its predecessor GPT-5.6 Cyber.

articles.title: ArcStation – Quick Setup Guide
articles.summary: I wanted to demonstrate how easy it is to install the ArcStation optical drive emulator, so I posted a “quick install” livestream. Hardware installation took less than ten minutes!

articles.title: Translating An Old Display To A New One
articles.summary: The display comes as part of a Samsung cash register that looks as though it comes from the 1990s, which is in keeping with it having a monochrome STN display.

articles.title: Apple explains how to turn off the new MacBook Pro’s glowing logo
articles.summary: The glowing Apple logo on the new MacBook Pro is controllable by software. It has 25kHz PWM and per-device calibration. CoreBrightness controls the relationship between screen and logo brightness.

articles.title: Google Find Hub rolls out ‘Notify when left behind’ tracker alerts on Android
articles.summary: There is a new “Notify when left behind” section to “Receive a notification when this tag is separated from your phone.” By default, there’s an exception for the Home address you’ve stored in your Google Account (Maps).

articles.title: Fanatical Platinum Collection (November 2026) game bundle is live with some treats
articles.summary: Fanatical just launched their Platinum Collection - Build your own Bundle (November 2026) and it has a number of good games in it for cheaps.

articles.title: Help Shape the Future of .NET: Take the 2026 .NET Developer Survey
articles.summary: Take the 2026 .NET Developer Survey to share your experience, help identify common challenges, and guide future .NET investments. The survey takes about 15 minutes.

articles.title: Phone by Google 246 beta brings gradient icon redesign on Android
articles.summary: Version 246 of Phone by Google — as the app is still officially called to presumably avoid the Pixel overlap that comes with “Google Phone” — is rolling out today to the beta channel.

articles.title: Sandboxing Untrusted AI Agents at Scale: Google Donates Agent Substrate and gVisor to the CNCF
articles.summary: This week at KubeCon North America in Salt Lake City, Google Cloud is donating Agent Substrate and gVisor to the Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) in Sandbox status, alongside OpenRL.

articles.title: Tripwire Presents expands publishing to focus on support of smaller indie teams
articles.summary: Tripwire Presents, the publishing division of Tripwire Interactive, announced a new initiative to expand support for smaller indie developers and games. Hopefully with some healthy contracts that allow developers just to keep doing what they do, and get paid nicely from it.

articles.title: Modernize your .NET apps for Windows Arm64 with GitHub Copilot
articles.summary: The GitHub Copilot upgrade agent helps you move from those questions to concrete changes. It assesses your .NET projects for migration from Windows x64 or x86 to Windows Arm64, identifies blockers, creates a migration plan, and helps update your code, dependencies, and configuration.

articles.title: OpenAI released a new cybersecurity model. Is that enough?
articles.summary: OpenAI appears to have noticed. Today, the AI giant announced a new model focused on cybersecurity, ChatGPT Cyber, would be made available to the highest tier of users in the cybersecurity program, Daybreak Red, which allows offensive cybersecurity researchers tools for vulnerability hunting and development.

articles.title: The Android 17 ColorOS 17 update is coming to 6 more OnePlus devices this month
articles.summary: OnePlus’s transformation into a fully controlled arm of Oppo is nearly final now that the Android 17 ColorOS 17 update schedule has been made public.

articles.title: Supercharging XLA-based inference: Announcing the launch of XLA Serving Engine
articles.summary: Today we are excited to announce the launch of XLA Serving Engine (XSE) , a general-purpose model export and inference runtime for the OpenXLA ecosystem , open-sourced under the Apache 2.0 license.

articles.title: Pillars of Eternity and Pillars of Eternity II: Deadfire get major updates with controller support in Beta
articles.summary: Obsidian Entertainment are again revamping some older games with both Pillars of Eternity and Pillars of Eternity II: Deadfire getting controller support. The updates for both games are currently in Beta, set to hopefully release for everyone before the year is up.

articles.title: What’s New in PyCharm 2026.3
articles.summary: PyCharm 2026.3 introduces JetBrains Air for agentic workflows – featuring free Junie Lite – alongside dedicated consoles and terminals per subproject in workspaces, support for Python 3.15 lazy imports, and interactive dependency graphs for FastAPI endpoints.

articles.title: Google's Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash stretches AI video clips to 15 seconds and cuts pricing by 30 percent
articles.summary: Google Deepmind is making its Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash video-generation model generally available. The updated model creates clips up to 15 seconds long, supports conversational editing, and costs 30 percent less than its predecessor.

articles.title: iOS 27.3 changes the iPhone Duo keyboard, here’s how
articles.summary: iPhone Duo has only been available for a couple weeks, but Apple keeps improving the product with software enhancements. The latest arrives in the iOS 27.3 beta via a convenient keyboard update.

articles.title: Claude can now analyze your spending with its new Personal Finance tool
articles.summary: Anthropic announced Thursday that Claude is getting a new tool called “Personal Finance,” designed to help users keep track of their money. With it, users can connect their bank and credit card accounts through Plaid and ask Claude questions about their finances.

articles.title: MacBook Pro with PROLED review, new iPad mini hands-on, and iOS 27.3 features
articles.summary: It’s another bumper week, with Chance’s hands-on reviews of both the new iPad mini and the new MacBook Pro to discuss, especially around just how good the OLED display looks, and how touchscreens fit into the Mac ecosystem.

articles.title: Baidu releases ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base with 280 billion parameters as an open-source foundation model
articles.summary: Baidu releases ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base: a 280-billion-parameter MoE model pre-trained on 33.5 trillion tokens, shipped deliberately without fine-tuning, so developers can take it wherever they want.

articles.title: Usage metrics API adds code review details and addressed rate
articles.summary: The enterprise and organization repository-level Copilot usage metrics reports now show what happens to Copilot code review feedback. A new copilot_code_review object on each repos-1-day row reports how many Copilot-reviewed pull requests merged without a later change request from a person and how many Copilot code review comments developers acted on.

articles.title: First iOS 27.3 and macOS Golden Gate 27.3 Public Betas Now Available
articles.summary: Apple today seeded the first betas of iOS 27.3, iPadOS 27.3, macOS Golden Gate 27.3, tvOS 27.3, and watchOS 27.3. The new software comes two days after Apple released the betas for developers.

articles.title: macOS 27.3 Golden Gate public beta 1 now available, here’s everything new
articles.summary: Following the release of macOS 27.3 developer beta 1 , Apple is now rolling out the first test build for users enrolled in the public beta.

articles.title: Usage metrics API flags telemetry and version gaps
articles.summary: The Copilot usage metrics API now shows which users are missing client telemetry or are running IDE or extension versions below the usage metrics minimums.

articles.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
articles.summary: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash generates clips up to 15 seconds long that hold references together better than before. You can scroll through to see characters, text, and camera moves stay consistent across longer shots, multiple turns and transitions with no cuts.

articles.title: Now available: Retention messages for subscriptions
articles.summary: In App Store Connect, you can configure retention messages for your auto-renewable subscriptions, including subscriber eligibility and the wait time between messages. With the Retention Messaging API , you can choose which message to show each subscriber based on their subscription details.

articles.title: New pull request overview page in public preview
articles.summary: To join, select the ✨ Try the Overview page button in the header. We’re opening this preview early so you can try the new direction on your own pull requests and help shape what comes next.
